title: Resume Ground Truth Annotation Schema
description: Schema for manual gold annotations of individual resume entities.

resume_id.description: Unique identifier for the candidate resume, matching file stem.

file_path.description: Relative path to the raw resume file (e.g. resumes/resume_01.txt).

skills.description: Categorized gold skills present in the resume, using standard dictionary category keys.

education.description: Gold education facts present in the resume.

experience.description: List of professional or internship experience entries.

projects.description: List of academic, personal, or key project entries.

certifications.description: List of certification strings recognized as gold credentials.

notes.description: Optional annotator notes or edge-case remarks.

evaluator_id.description: Anonymized pseudonymous identifier of the annotator (e.g. evaluator_01).

adjudicated.description: Whether this record is a post-disagreement consensus/adjudicated record.
